consentScope: Internal repository example and anonymized migration evidence; no external adopter claim is made.

source.workload: HTTP client, inbound trace propagation, metrics, health, and graceful shutdown

migration.includes: facade migration, packed install harness, two failed smoke diagnoses, correction, and successful end-to-end run

negativeFindings: The first harness layout installed dependencies below the shared source, so module resolution failed; staging now mirrors the examples-level dependency boundary.
The initial smoke expected a generated span ID in the immutable inbound trace field; it now supplies a W3C traceparent and verifies propagation of that exact trace ID.
RuntimeService and makeConfigLayer are absent from the documented v2 preview and remain isolated on the supported v1 core entrypoint.
The beta rehearsal passed without adding root exports, confirming that the two bootstrap gaps belong on /core for now.
rollbackPath: Change examples/shared/src/brass.ts back to brass-runtime/core and restore the former direct imports; the example persists no application data.
limitations: This is an internal offline example with a fake upstream transport, not an external deployment.
The smoke proves request behavior and graceful shutdown once; it is not a load, soak, or fault-injection result.
CPU, heap, RSS, latency percentiles, retention, and upgrade lag are outside this migration record.
The shared facade serves several framework examples, but only the Express consumer was installed and executed in this run.
The beta candidate was packed and installed locally; this is not registry or external-production evidence.
reproduce: node scripts/analyze-v2-migration.mjs --json examples; npm run validate:example:express -- --runtime-tarball <brass-runtime-1.22.0.tgz>; npm run validate:example:express -- --runtime-tarball <brass-runtime-2.0.0-beta.0.tgz>
